Hi Sarah — thanks for the kickoff earlier today. Per discussion, below is a consolidated checklist (what we need from you) and what you will receive from Redwood. Please use the Drive folder to upload items and reply here with any timing constraints.

What we need from you (please upload to: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3cRedwoodVendorOnboarding):
- Completed ProcurePlus_onboarding_questionnaire.docx (we will not start vendor setup without this)
- Signed W-9 (or equivalent tax form) — required for US vendors
- Certificate of insurance (COI) listing Redwood Inference as certificate holder; minimum limits: General Liability $1M
- Bank remit instructions (voided check or bank letter) OR confirmation of AP email for e-invoice submission
- Primary business contact, invoicing contact, escalation contact (name / role / phone / email)

What Redwood will provide / do after we receive the items above:
- Create vendor record in NetSuite and send vendor code (expected within 2 business days)
- Issue first PO within 5 business days of executed SOW + valid invoice and tax docs
- Provide a PO template and Redwood_PO_Instructions.pdf (attached) that explains PO numbering (RWI-YYYY-####) and invoice requirements
- Finance contact for escalation: laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com; Legal contact for contract questions: vivek_kulkarni@redwoodinference.com

Notes / exceptions:
- Payment terms default to Net30; if ProcurePlus requires Net45 for the first 60 days, we can consider but will need Finance approval (Laura).
- If ProcurePlus requires a paper contract signature, route to Vivek for redlines; otherwise we can proceed with existing SOW template.

Attachments included: Redwood_PO_Instructions.pdf (PO expectations & invoice checklist).

Next steps: please upload the requested docs and confirm AP email so we can finish vendor setup. I’ll confirm the vendor code once NetSuite is complete.

Thanks again — looking forward to moving this across the finish line.

—
